content: Kadhakina Maanusia Inda Moparacaeana Kawasana Opu

content.text: Mia mokabhongo-bhongo apogau i nuncana ngangarandana,
"Inda dhaangia o Aulataʼala."
Pewauna manga incia amadhaki tee atomarika,
inda dhaangia mopewauna kalape.
Minaaka i sorogaa KAWASANA OPU atonto
anana maanusia,
to akamata ara dhaangia o mia moʼaarifu,
mopeelona Aulataʼala.
Bhari-bharia mia abholi dhala mobanara tee akarajaa giu momadhaki.
Inda dhaangia mopewauna kalape, moomini samia uka.
Firimanina Aulataʼala, "Buaka apesua i akala, ande bhari-bharia mia mopewauna kadhaki inda amatau giu momalape?
Manga incia apekaoge karona tee akande uumatiku mboomo akande roti,
tee inda adoʼa i Iaku."
Iwe sumai manga incia bheamaeka mpuu
roonamo Aulataʼala atulungi uumatina mobanara.
Ingkomiu bheupekaea haejatina mia motopisaki,
maka o KAWASANA OPU amembali peulusana manga incia.
Maasangia kasalaamati to miana Israel aumba minaaka i Sion, kotana Aulataʼala!
Wakutuuna KAWASANA OPU apambuli kadhaangiana uumatina,
siwuluna Yakub bheamasanaa o namisina tee o Israel bheakaunde-unde.
